title: helenium nuttallii
intro: Helenium nuttallii, commonly known as the Nuttall's sneezeweed, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is used in herbal medicine to treat various ailments, including colds, fever, and respiratory issues due to its health benefits such as reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Helenium nuttallii include its ability to relieve sinus congestion, reduce fever, and soothe respiratory irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
